name: figma_screenshot
description: Capture a visual PNG screenshot of specific nodes or the current selection in Figma. ALWAYS use this or 'capture: true' in figma_execute_code to visually inspect and critique your design output, verify layout alignment, colors, padding, and font rendering.

node_ids.description: Optional comma-separated list of Figma node IDs to screenshot (e.g. '123:456, 123:457'). If omitted, captures current selection or current page.

description.description: Optional action description for Figma toast and logs.
